job.title: BDM - Light Towers
job.description:
Our client is a global manufacturer and distributor of power and construction equipment - generators, battery storage systems, air compressors and lighting towers. They're a genuine manufacturer with a full sales and aftersales operation, and they're growing. This is a newly created BDM role focused specifically on their lighting tower range.

The role

This is a new business role first and foremost. You'll be on the road, building a national customer base from the ground up - direct to civil contractors, commercial builders, hire companies and distributors. You'll sell lighting towers primarily as capital equipment, with short-term hire available as a trial tool. Order values range from small accounts through to 10-20 unit volume purchases, and the Year 1 revenue target is $8M. You'll manage both direct and channel sales, deal with contacts from site level through to procurement and senior management, and stay across the full sales cycle from first contact to close.
The role is based in Smithfield, NSW with regular interstate travel.

What they're looking for

They want a senior BDM who has sold machinery or equipment into construction, civil or energy markets. Someone who is comfortable opening doors, managing a pipeline and closing. You need to be happy travelling nationally, dealing with Tier 1 through to Tier 4 contractors, and working autonomously without much hand-holding.

What's on offer
  • Up to $120,000 base salary + Super
  • Fully maintained vehicle
  • Commissions - circa $80,000 OTE

job.title: Senior Application Engineer
job.description:
The opportunity

This is a senior technical pre-sales role with a well-established manufacturer of inspection and detection equipment. Based at the Head Office in South Melbourne, you'll be the person who validates every solution before it goes to quote — meaning every deal in this business unit passes through you. It's a high-trust, largely autonomous position with real line-of-sight to broader commercial responsibility over time.

About the company

A specialist manufacturer supplying check-weighing, X-ray inspection and metal detection equipment to food & beverage, FMCG, logistics and home goods operations across Australia and New Zealand. Equipment is configured to the application (not sold off the shelf) with deal values typically range from $50K to $1M.

What you'll be doing
  • Partnering with the sales team (approx. 70% of the role) to design, validate and cost technical solutions — primarily via Teams, with site visits for complex applications
  • Reviewing and signing off on proposed solutions across the business — from quick sanity checks to deep technical involvement
  • Engaging directly with end users and OEM partners (approx. 30% of your time) including plant managers, engineering managers and senior stakeholders
  • Supporting the commissioning team on complex post-sale issues as needed — this role is approximately 90% pre-sales
  • Liaising with European operations, which means occasional early starts or later finishes during peak periods
What we're looking for
  • Mechanical engineering qualification — this is non-negotiable
  • Hands-on exposure to production or process-line environments involving conveying, packaging or palletising — food & beverage, FMCG, logistics and materials handling all suit well
  • Ability to operate with genuine autonomy from day one
  • Comfortable in a senior technical/commercial seat without needing heavy oversight
Backgrounds that fit well: design engineer, project engineer, sales application engineer, senior field service engineer with commercial acumen, or a senior site/plant engineer from food & beverage or FMCG.

What's in it for you
  • Base salary $120,000–$130,000 (with flexibility for the right person)
  • Car allowance ~$18,000 p.a. plus fuel card and tolls (or company vehicle if preferred)
  • Bonus/commission scheme
  • Approx. 80% office-based — not a heavy travel role
  • A senior seat with real influence on how deals are structured and won
  • Genuine pathway to broader business responsibility for those who want it
